anika: Heads-up — finance wants us to cut spot spend by ~15% this quarter. We should revisit the mixed-pool strategy and interruption handling before the next capacity commit. Any low-risk ideas? :wave:
ben: Short thought: split pools by workload SLA (interactive vs batch) and prefer spot for batch w/ aggressive checkpointing. interactive -> reserved/dedicated. Keeps user latency predictable. :thumbsup:
jules: Agree. Also consider dynamic spot bid thresholds per region (where cloud offers variable preempt rates). If preempt probability > 5% for the hour, move batch jobs to a secondary region or throttle start rate. :eyes:
vikram: We already have this in partial form — but two gaps: 1) no quick offload path when a region spike happens, 2) queue priorities are flat so interactive jobs sometimes starve batch on shared nodes.
anika: For 1) what about an automated fallback that migrates queued batch pods to a warm reserve pool (cheaper dedicated GPUs we own) when we detect >N evictions in 10m? For 2) can we add queue weights?
ben: +1. Implementation sketch:
```
# pseudo-config
pools:
  - name: spot-batch
    type: spot
    eviction_threshold: 0.05 # 5% per 10m
    checkpoint_s3: s3://redwood-checkpoints/batch/
  - name: reserved-interactive
    type: reserved
    max_latency_ms: 150
routing:
  batch_queue: {priority: low, fallback: warm-reserve}
  interactive_queue: {priority: high}
```
If eviction_threshold breached -> controller copies jobs to warm-reserve and pauses new spot starts for 10m.
jules: We should also emit a short-lived metric "spot_eviction_rate" and alert at 3x baseline. Ops can then manually flip region or increase reserved cap.
vikram: Checkpointing will be the pain point. For some long TF jobs we need 2x checkpoint frequency to avoid rework after preemption. That increases network egress and S3 costs — need cost calc.
anika: Good call — include cost delta in the playbook. Also propose running lower-priority background training in off-peak windows (UTC 0200-0800) and auto-scale up spot batch capacity then. Less chance of contention with interactive.
ben: One more ops detail: have the spot termination handler send events to the controller with the pod UID and node id. Controller should delay reschedule for a short randomized backoff so we don't thrash when many pods get preempted simultaneously.
vikram: Backoff algorithm: exponential random with jitter, cap 60s. Also prioritize pods that have recent checkpoints.
anika: Can someone put together a short runbook and the k8s Job/queue config? Would like a PR by EOD Fri so we can test next week. :calendar:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: New issue created: infra/spot-fallback-playbook (#4521) by anika — https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/4521
ben: I'll draft the config and tests. I'll include a small load test to simulate a region preempt event and verify backoff/failed-retry behavior.
jules: I'll add the metric dashboards (eviction_rate, avg_restart_count, checkpoint_latency) and a riot test for the off-peak shift window.
anika: Awesome. If we can show cost delta + SLO impact, should be easy to get finance sign-off. :rocket:
